title: Agent Chat: raise/relax the 24-step cap so long tasks complete (configurable, keep a backstop)
description:
USER REPORT: The Agent Chat stops mid-task after ~24 steps; the user wants no max (or a much higher cap) so the agent keeps working until the task is actually complete.

CONFIRMED (file:line + current value):
- packages/authoring-ui/src/agentchat/AgentChatPanel.tsx:52 -> const MAX_STEPS = 24;
- AgentChatPanel.tsx:260 passes maxSteps: MAX_STEPS into runTurn (runAgentTurn).
- packages/authoring-ui/src/agentchat/agentLoop.ts:508 -> stopWhen: stepCountIs(maxSteps) inside streamText. So the tool loop HARD-STOPS after 24 model steps regardless of whether the task is done.

DESIGN FRAMING (important):
- The agent loop ALREADY terminates naturally when the model stops emitting tool calls: the 'finish' event flips state to 'done' (agentLoop.ts:298-301, reduceAgentEvent), i.e. finishReason:'stop'. So under normal completion the loop ends on its own.
- stepCountIs(MAX_STEPS) is therefore a SAFETY BACKSTOP against a runaway/looping agent (infinite tool calls -> unbounded token cost + hang), tied to the 1282 destructive-op safety concern.
- Truly 'no max / unbounded' is RISKY: a stuck/looping agent would loop until it crashes or drains cost. So we should NOT simply remove the cap.
- The user can already halt a long run manually via the Stop button (controller.abort(), onAbort -> 'stopped').

RECOMMENDED FIX:
(a) RAISE the default cap substantially (e.g. 100-200) so legitimate long authoring tasks complete; AND/OR
(b) Make it USER-CONFIGURABLE via AgentSettings (a maxSteps setting, generous default), threaded through to AgentChatPanel's maxSteps prop;
WHILE KEEPING a backstop (never truly unbounded).
(c) Optionally pair with a token/cost budget guard (ties to the 1282 safety follow-up) so the backstop bounds cost even if step count is raised high.

PRIORITY: medium -- the 24-step cap materially limits the agent's usefulness on real multi-step authoring tasks.
